events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Icon
angles.copy: Still very much a force in music, Liam Gallagher is 54 today. What's your favourite track from the legendary Oasis frontman?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 24, 1975, celebrating its 51st anniversary.

angles.name: Powerful Message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon’s 'Imagine' landed as a single in the UK. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: First iPod announced 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple announced the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Music
angles.copy: Remember when 1,000 songs in your pocket seemed impossible? The first iPod was announced 25 years ago this month, changing music forever.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and which theme song gets you in the mood for espionage?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and vision of John Lennon. His music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' 58th anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, iconic 'White Album'. What's your standout track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's 35th death anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Forever a Champion
angles.copy: Remembering the irreplaceable Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice and showmanship continue to captivate the world.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' 61st anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Game Changer Album
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped, marking a pivotal shift in their sound. A true classic.

events.title: John Lennon's 46th death anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His legacy of peace, love, and incredible music lives on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music legend David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true chameleon of rock whose influence is still felt today.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. The King of Rock and Roll forever.
